name: subagent-cost
description: Shows what each subagent cost and how much of your 5-hour and 7-day quota is used, compacts after a finished task, and asks Claude for a handoff brief before the quota runs out.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the rows and notices: en or zh.

subagentModelPolicy.title: Subagent model policy
subagentModelPolicy.description: warn: a notice when a subagent runs on an inherited Opus/Fable/Mythos model. off: no notice. downgrade:<model> (e.g. downgrade:sonnet): once a subagent type has been seen running on an Opus/Fable/Mythos main session's model with no model passed, later subagents of that type run on <model> instead. The first spawn of each type is not changed, a model passed in the call is kept, and a type whose definition names the same model as the main session counts as inheriting.

autoCompact.title: Compact after a finished task
autoCompact.description: auto: compact after a turn that answered (not one that ended with a question) once the context passes a threshold. ask: offer a button instead. off: never.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at context percent
compactAtPercent.description: Context window fill, in percent, that counts as large. 0 turns this test off.

compactAtTokens.title: Compact at context tokens
compactAtTokens.description: Context tokens that count as large, whichever of the two comes first. 0 turns this test off.

warnAt.title: Warn at 5-hour percent
warnAt.description: 5-hour window percentage that turns the summary row into a warning and shows one notice.

handoffAt.title: Handoff at 5-hour percent
handoffAt.description: 5-hour window percentage at which Claude is asked to write the handoff brief and start no new large task.

warnAt7d.title: Warn at 7-day percent
warnAt7d.description: The same warning for the 7-day window.

handoffAt7d.title: Handoff at 7-day percent
handoffAt7d.description: The same handoff for the 7-day window.

handoffPath.title: Handoff file
handoffPath.description: Where Claude writes the handoff brief; a relative path is relative to the session's working directory.
